$schema: Coqui source map — describes every core source file so the agent can understand its own codebase.

layers.agent: Agent classes — the orchestrator and child agent implementations
layers.command: Symfony Console commands — CLI entry points and REPL loop
layers.config: Configuration, safety, and discovery — workspace management, credential resolution, toolkit discovery
layers.contract: Interfaces and value objects — the contracts that define extensibility points
layers.tool: Tools — individual capabilities the agent can invoke during conversation
layers.toolkit: Toolkits — groups of related tools with shared guidelines
layers.observer: Observers — real-time event rendering for terminal output
layers.storage: Storage — SQLite-backed session and audit persistence
layers.coqui-space: Coqui Space — marketplace integration for discovering, installing, and managing skills and toolkits

files.description: Top-level orchestrator agent. Extends AbstractAgent. Registers all toolkits (FilesystemToolkit, ShellToolkit with configurable allowlist, MemoryToolkit, ProjectSourceToolkit, ToolkitGeneratorToolkit, SkillToolkit, auto-discovered toolkits) and all standalone tools (spawn_agent, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, summarize_conversation). Shell allowlist is resolved from agents.defaults.shellAllowedCommands in openclaw.json or falls back to DEFAULT_SHELL_COMMANDS (includes curl, wget). Memory is SQLite-backed via MemoryStore with FTS5 full-text search and optional vector embeddings; core memory summary is auto-injected into instructions(). Resolves a ContextWindow from ModelDefinition at construction time and passes it to AbstractAgent for per-iteration token budget enforcement. Constructed fresh on every REPL turn.

tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns standalone tools (spawn, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, summarize_conversation)

files.description: Handles agent creation, execution, and turn message persistence. Manages the full turn lifecycle: creates a turn record before execution, tracks timing, extracts tool usage and child agent counts, and completes the turn with all metadata after execution. Includes autoSummarizeIfNeeded() for pre-turn budget checks with workflow context injection, and autoExtractMemories() which runs LLM-based memory extraction after each successful turn (configurable via agents.defaults.memory.autoExtract). Accepts optional TodoStore and ArtifactStore to build workflow context for summarization.

files.description: Diagnostic 'doctor' command that checks 10 health categories: PHP environment (version, extensions, memory, putenv), config (openclaw.json validity, primary model, roles), workspace (directory, writable, composer.json, autoloader), database (existence, connection, tables, stats, message integrity with per-session UTF-8 scan), credentials (.env existence, permissions), providers (Ollama connectivity + model listing, cloud API key presence), toolkits (installed.json validity, class autoloadability), skills (directory, SKILL.md presence), launcher (bin/coqui-launcher executable), and disk space. Supports --repair flag to auto-fix issues (create missing dirs, init composer.json, fix .env permissions, repair malformed UTF-8 in messages, delete unfixable rows). Supports --json for machine-readable output.

files.description: ToolExecutionPolicyInterface implementation. Prompts user for confirmation on gated tools. Catastrophic blacklist checked first (no prompt — just blocked). Gated tools configured via $gatedTools map (tool name → rule list). Supports four rule types: wildcard ['*'], action-string matching, predicate objects {'arg': value}, and presence checks {'arg': '*'}. Rules use OR semantics; predicate internals use AND. Forwards turnId to logAudit.

files.description: Maps role names to provider/model strings and resolves per-role iteration limits. Model priority: role file model field → openclaw.json → primary model. files.description: Static analysis of generated PHP code. Blocks dangerous functions (eval, exec, system, passthru, shell_exec, proc_open, etc.) and filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, fopen, mkdir, unlink, rename, copy, etc.) to prevent writes to the project root. Also blocks patterns (backtick execution, privilege escalation, pipe to shell). In --unsafe mode, only catastrophic patterns are enforced.

isUnsafe(): bool — whether running in unsafe mode

files.description: Manages Coqui self-updates and workspace dependency updates. Checks for outdated packages via `composer outdated --format=json --direct` and applies updates via `composer update`. Path-repository packages (source.type=path / symlinks) are excluded from the outdated count since composer update cannot resolve them and they would otherwise cause an infinite auto-update restart loop. After applyUpdates(), RunCommand re-checks the count and only triggers a restart if the outdated count actually decreased. Controlled by COQUI_CHECK_UPDATES and COQUI_AUTO_UPDATE env vars stored in the workspace .env.
methods: isCheckEnabled(): bool — whether startup update checking is enabled (default: true)
isAutoUpdateEnabled(): bool — whether auto-update is enabled (default: false)

files.description: Executes generated PHP code in a sandboxed subprocess. cwd is workspace, open_basedir restricts filesystem access. ScriptSanitizer blocks filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, mkdir, unlink, etc.) at the static analysis level before code runs, preventing writes to the project root. Auto-prepends bootstrap preamble (strict_types, project + workspace autoloaders, .env loader). Output truncated to 32KB. Security: ScriptSanitizer (static check) + open_basedir (runtime restriction) + InteractiveApprovalPolicy (user confirmation) + timeout.

files.description: Agent-facing tool that triggers a graceful restart of Coqui. Sets a restartRequested flag on RunCommand via a closure callback. After the current agent turn completes, the REPL loop checks the flag and exits with RESTART_EXIT_CODE (10). The launcher script detects this exit code and relaunches the process. Gated by execution policy — requires user confirmation unless --auto-approve is enabled.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — sets restart flag via closure, returns success message with reason

files.description: Agent-facing tool for image analysis. Wraps VisionAnalyzer to expose a vision_analyze tool that accepts an image source (file path, URL, or base64 data URI) and an optional prompt. Delegates model resolution, provider routing, and multimodal message construction to VisionAnalyzer. Detects 'Error: ' prefixed responses from VisionAnalyzer and returns them as ToolResult::error() so the agent sees specific failure reasons.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — validates image parameter, delegates to VisionAnalyzer, returns ToolResult::success() or ToolResult::error() with descriptive message

files.description: Agent-facing tool for on-demand conversation summarization. Exposes a summarize_conversation tool with scope (all/recent), keep_recent (1-20), and focus parameters. Resolves a cheap provider via utility model resolution. Accepts optional TodoStore and ArtifactStore to build workflow context injected into the summarization prompt. Delegates to ConversationSummarizer for the actual compression.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — validates parameters, resolves provider, builds workflow context, delegates to ConversationSummarizer, returns summary metrics

files.description: Spawns child agents with role-specific models and toolkits. Uses RoleDiscovery access_level (full/readonly/minimal) to determine toolkit assignment, falling back to hardcoded defaults. Passes RoleDiscovery to ChildAgent for file-based role instructions. Accepts a configurable shell allowlist from OrchestratorAgent; child agents use DEFAULT_CHILD_SHELL_COMMANDS or the parent-supplied list. Applies per-package visibility from ToolkitVisibilityRegistry (Disabled skipped, Stub treated as Enabled since children lack tool_search). Discovered toolkits are wrapped with child-mode credential guards. Optionally includes BackgroundTaskToolkit for full-access children when agents.defaults.childBackgroundTasks is enabled.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — resolves role to model, builds toolkits, runs child agent

Guidelines dynamically show progress bar, active/pending listing with artifact cross-references, and post-summarization recovery hints.

files.description: Agent-facing project and sprint management toolkit providing 9 tools: project_create, project_list, project_get, project_update, sprint_create, sprint_list, sprint_get, sprint_transition, sprint_update. Projects persist across sessions. Sprints follow a 4-state lifecycle (planned→in_progress→review→complete/rejected). Dynamic guidelines show active project and sprint progress when a sprint is linked to the current session.

guidelines(): string — dynamic active project/sprint summary with progress bar, empty when no active sprint

files.description: Agent-facing toolkit for the evaluator role. Visibility restricted via the evaluator role's toolkits frontmatter field. Provides 4 tools for introspecting past sessions and recording structured evaluation reports: evaluation_list_sessions, evaluation_read_transcript, evaluation_read_child_runs, evaluation_save_report. files.description: Automatically generates todos from finalized plan artifacts. Follows the TitleGenerator pattern: single-shot LLM call via utility model, best-effort, never propagates errors. Loads instructions from the plan-todo-generator role file via RoleDiscovery (falling back to FALLBACK_INSTRUCTIONS). Extracts actionable implementation steps as structured JSON and creates linked todos via TodoStore::bulkCreate(). Invoked automatically by ArtifactToolkit when a plan artifact reaches 'final' stage.

files.description: Analyzes images using a vision-capable model. Mirrors TitleGenerator pattern — single-shot child agent that reads 'vision' role instructions and delegates to a vision model. Accepts file paths, URLs, and base64 data URIs. Pre-downloads URL images to base64 data URIs for universal provider compatibility. Returns descriptive 'Error: ...' strings on failure instead of null, enabling agents to surface real failure reasons (HTTP errors, unsupported formats, missing files).
